principles: The preregistered gold labels, question wording, order and the lenient any-of rule are never changed. The overlay adds a second, stricter scoring computed from the SAME retrieval.
A chunk earns strict credit alone only if it is independently sufficient to answer the question.
A fragment that cannot answer by itself never earns strict credit alone. Where an answer is split across chunks, strict credit requires every member of a declared joint set to be in the context.
Alternative evidence is admitted only if the frozen text of that chunk contains the answer; the supporting passage is recorded and was asserted to be an exact substring of the chunk.
Chunks that answer a different question are listed as not_evidence and never count.
The frozen corpus and the preregistration are not modified.

scoring_semantics.context: The first 3 chunks (K_FINAL = 3) of a pipeline's ranked list.
scoring_semantics.lenient_success: Any preregistered gold chunk is in the Top 3 (the original rule, unchanged).
scoring_semantics.strict_success: Any sufficient_single chunk is in the Top 3, OR every member of at least one joint set is in the Top 3.
scoring_semantics.strict_partial: Reported separately and never counted as success: some but not all members of a joint set are in the Top 3, or the only preregistered gold chunks in the Top 3 are excluded_from_strict fragments.
scoring_semantics.strict_retrieval_stumble: Not strict success, but a sufficient_single chunk is within the Top 10, or every member of a joint set is within the Top 10.
scoring_semantics.strict_candidate_pool_miss: None of the above within the Top 10.
scoring_semantics.strict_gold_rank: Smallest rank among sufficient_single chunks; for a joint set, the largest rank among its members; overall the smallest over all options.
scoring_semantics.unchanged_questions: For the questions listed in unchanged_questions the strict rule equals the preregistered any-of gold set.

extraction_defect.description: A paragraph that crosses a PDF page break was left unjoined: the sentence runs from the last line of PDF page 36 ('...Collaborative Information') to the first line of PDF page 37 ('Sharing Environment [DCISE], ...').
extraction_defect.cause: The stitching rule joined page-break continuations only when the next paragraph began with a lowercase letter; this one begins with a capital letter ('Sharing'). The chunker then kept the two pieces as separate blocks, and the chunk boundary fell inside the sentence.
extraction_defect.verified_against_pdf: PDF p.36 last body line: 'sector partners (e.g., Defense Industrial Base [DIB] using the DoD-Defense Industrial Base Collaborative Information'; PDF p.37 first body line: 'Sharing Environment [DCISE], Information Sharing and Analysis Centers [ISACs] for critical infrastructure sectors),'.
extraction_defect.scope: A corpus-wide scan of consecutive same-section chunk pairs found exactly two whose earlier chunk ends without terminal punctuation: nt-121/nt-122 (this defect) and nt-154/nt-155 (a list item continuing in the next bullet, not a gold passage).
